L692: # How to download file?【686†¶】
L693: ## Download file manually【687†¶】
L694: 
L695: First, you must get the file_id of the file you want to download. Information about files sent to the bot is contained in 【159†Message】.

L708: After that, use the 【688†download_file】 method from the bot object.

L734: ### Download file to disk【691†¶】

L692: # How to download file?【686†¶】
L693: ## Download file manually【687†¶】
L694: 
L695: First, you must get the file_id of the file you want to download. Information about files sent to the bot is contained in 【159†Message】.
L696: 
L697: For example, download the document that came to the bot.
L698: 
L699:     file_id = message.document.file_id
L700: 
L701: 
L702: Then use the 【472†getFile】 method to get file_path.
L703: 
L704:     file = await bot.get_file(file_id)
L705:     file_path = file.file_path
L706: 
L707: 
L708: After that, use the 【688†download_file】 method from the bot object.
L709: ### download_file(…)【688†¶】
L710: 
L711: Download file by file_path to destination.
L712: 
L713: If you want to automatically create destination (`io.BytesIO`) use default value of destination and handle result of this method.
L714: 
L715: async Bot.download_file(file_path: str | Path, destination: BinaryIO | Path | str | None = None, timeout: int = 30, chunk_size: int = 65536, seek: bool = True) → BinaryIO | None【689†[source]】【690†¶】
L716: 
L717: 
L718: Download file by file_path to destination.
L719: If you want to automatically create destination (`io.BytesIO`) use default value of destination and handle result of this method.
L720: 
L721: Parameters:
L722: 
L723: 
L724:   * file_path – File path on Telegram server (You can get it from `aiogram.types.File`)
L725: 
L726:   * destination – Filename, file path or instance of `io.IOBase`. For e.g. `io.BytesIO`, defaults to None
L727: 
L728:   * timeout – Total timeout in seconds, defaults to 30
L729: 
L730:   * chunk_size – File chunks size, defaults to 64 kb
L731:   * seek – Go to start of file when downloading is finished. Used only for destination with `typing.BinaryIO` type, defaults to True
L732: 
L733: There are two options where you can download the file: to disk or to binary I/O object.
L734: ### Download file to disk【691†¶】
L735: 
L736: To download file to disk, you must specify the file name or path where to download the file. In this case, the function will return nothing.
L737: 
L738:     await bot.download_file(file_path, "text.txt")
L739: ### Download file to binary I/O object【692†¶】
L740: 
L741: To download file to binary I/O object, you must specify an object with the `typing.BinaryIO` type or use the default (`None`) value.
L742: 
L743: In the first case, the function will return your object:
L744: 
L745:     my_object = MyBinaryIO()
L746:     result: MyBinaryIO = await bot.download_file(file_path, my_object)
L747:     # print(result is my_object)  # True
L748: If you leave the default value, an `io.BytesIO` object will be created and returned.
L749: 
L750:     result: io.BytesIO = await bot.download_file(file_path)
L751: ## Download file in short way【693†¶】
L752: 
L753: Getting file_path manually every time is boring, so you should use the 【694†download】 method.
L754: ### download(…)【694†¶】
L755: 
L756: Download file by file_id or Downloadable object to destination.
L757: 
L758: If you want to automatically create destination (`io.BytesIO`) use default value of destination and handle result of this method.
L759: 
L760: async Bot.download(file: str | Downloadable, destination: BinaryIO | Path | str | None = None, timeout: int = 30, chunk_size: int = 65536, seek: bool = True) → BinaryIO | None【695†[source]】【696†¶】
L761: 
L762: 
L763: Download file by file_id or Downloadable object to destination.
L764: If you want to automatically create destination (`io.BytesIO`) use default value of destination and handle result of this method.
L765: 
L766: Parameters:
L767: 
L768: 
L769:   * file – file_id or Downloadable object
L770: 
L771:   * destination – Filename, file path or instance of `io.IOBase`. For e.g. `io.BytesIO`, defaults to None
L772: 
L773:   * timeout – Total timeout in seconds, defaults to 30
L774: 
L775:   * chunk_size – File chunks size, defaults to 64 kb
L776:   * seek – Go to start of file when downloading is finished. Used only for destination with `typing.BinaryIO` type, defaults to True
L777: 
L778: It differs from 【688†download_file】 only in that it accepts file_id or an Downloadable object (object that contains the file_id attribute) instead of file_path.
L779: 
L780: You can download a file to 【691†disk】 or to a 【697†binary I/O】 object in the same way.
L781: 
L782: Example:
L783: 
L784:     document = message.document
L785:     await bot.download(document)

Используйте `answer_video_note()` или `bot.send_video_note()`. Обычное видео нужно **скачать и загрузить заново**: Telegram запрещает менять тип медиа при повторной отправке по `file_id`. [Документация](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)

Пример для существующего бота на aiogram 3. Нужен установленный **FFmpeg**; подключите `router` через `dp.include_router(router)`.

```python
import asyncio
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from aiogram import Bot, F, Router
from aiogram.types import FSInputFile, Message

router = Router()


@router.message(F.video)
@router.message(F.document.mime_type.startswith("video/"))
async def make_video_note(message: Message, bot: Bot):
    media = message.video or message.document

    # Ограничение скачивания через облачный Bot API.
    if media.file_size and media.file_size > 20 * 1024 * 1024:
        await message.answer("Для этого бота пришлите видео до 20 МБ.")
        return

    with TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        source = Path(tmp) / "input"
        result = Path(tmp) / "note.mp4"
        await bot.download(media, destination=source)

        try:
            await asyncio.to_thread(
                subprocess.run,
                [
                    "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-y", "-loglevel", "error",
                    "-i", str(source), "-t", "60",
                    "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "0:a:0?",
                    "-vf",
                    "scale=640:640:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,"
                    "crop=640:640,setsar=1,fps=30",
                    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast",
                    "-crf", "23", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "64k",
                    "-movflags", "+faststart",
                    str(result),
                ],
                check=True,
                timeout=120,
                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            )
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            await message.answer("Не удалось обработать видео.")
            return

        if result.stat().st_size > 50 * 1024 * 1024:
            await message.answer("После обработки файл превышает 50 МБ.")
            return

        await message.answer_video_note(
            video_note=FSInputFile(result),
            length=640,
        )
```

Код скачивает файл средствами [aiogram 3](https://docs.aiogram.dev/en/latest/api/download_file.html), обрезает кадр по центру до квадрата и оставляет первые 60 секунд. FFmpeg работает в отдельном потоке; временные файлы удаляются после отправки.

Требования и нюансы:

- **Квадратное MPEG4-видео длительностью до 60 секунд.** Круглое отображение обеспечивает Telegram. Размер `640×640` выбран для примера; `length` только описывает сторону квадрата и сам ничего не масштабирует. Прямая отправка по URL не поддерживается. [sendVideoNote](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideonote)
- Для совместимости используйте **MP4, H.264, `yuv420p`**, при наличии звука — AAC, как в примере.
- У облачного Bot API разные лимиты: **скачивание до 20 МБ**, новая загрузка — **до 50 МБ**. [getFile](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getfile), [отправка файлов](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
- Если пользователь прислал уже готовый кружок, его можно отправить напрямую: `await message.answer_video_note(message.video_note.file_id)`. [Документация](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideonote)
